semantics.timing: Pure combinational gate; output responds to current inputs without clocked latency.

numeric.operation: Bitwise inversion of in2 followed by bitwise AND with in1.
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, signedness conversion, rounding, truncation, saturation, or overflow.

verification.plan: Independent self-checking testbench enumerates all four binary input combinations and compares against literal truth-table outputs after combinational settling, then repeats in reverse order to check input responsiveness.
verification.compile: Icarus Verilog v12, -g2012, explicit top dev_tb, finite external timeout.
verification.simulation: Matching vvp with finite external timeout and PASS/FAIL marker.
verification.scope: Development verification only; no official evaluation or synthesis.
